DreamBot · Instagram ad concepts

20 ways to stop the scroll.

Funny-first ad memes in DreamBot's own voice: dreamy, playful, a little cheeky. Real app art (that's our actual bedazzled mariachi taco and the DreamBot mascot), recognizable meme formats bent to our world, and a few bespoke ones. These are layout + copy mockups to react to, not final renders. Pick the winners and I'll produce them as real 1:1 / 4:5 / 9:16 files.

20

Dream It. Make It.

Brand anchor / end card

The real ASC hero. Every ad ends here so the ad and the App Store rhyme.

Unifying rules baked into every mockup: deep-dark dreamy ground · purple→pink→teal gradient · rounded display type (matches the app) · glowing lavender/gradient caption pills · sparkles · always the mascot or a jewel-cute hero · no em dashes · ends on “Dream it. Make it.” to rhyme with the App Store hero.
My picks to run first: 01 Prompt Reveal · 03 Drake · 06 How It Started / Going · 18 Not a Toy Not a Movie. Tell me which to build and I'll composite the real files.
